justification: Both surfaces depict human figures and include a round disc/rosette-type motif, but that is the extent of shared content: A is a single massive frontal figure with a few isolated, schematic emblems (a disc, curving bands, incised marks) on its body, while B is a horizontal narrative procession of profile figures leading horned animals past a conifer tree, framed above and below by continuous rosette borders. The relationships (led animals, attendants with staffs, framing registers) and the fine naturalistic, patterned relief style of B have no counterpart in A's blocky, schematic, single-figure composition.
